subject: Web Development
title: Render-Blocking Resources
description: A quick win: understand Render-Blocking Resources.

hook.text: CSS and synchronous scripts can freeze the entire rendering pipeline until they load.

buildup.text: The browser pauses painting when it encounters a stylesheet it hasn't downloaded yet.

discovery.text: Scripts without 'async' or 'defer' halt HTML parsing completely while they execute.

twist.text: A tiny analytics script in the head tag can delay your entire above-the-fold content.

climax.text: Identifying and eliminating render blockers is the fastest way to improve load time.

punchline.text: The fastest resource is the one you don't block on.

quiz.question: What can block the browser from rendering?
